payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Set up payments so your widget can receive tips.
payments.countryHint: Where you or your business is based. This cannot be changed later.
payments.siteUrlHint: The address the widget runs on. Payments are only accepted from this site.
payments.siteUrlInvalid: Enter a valid site address, for example example.com
payments.currencyHint: Supporters are charged in this currency. It follows your country unless you change it.
payments.detailsIncomplete: Fill in all four before you continue.
payments.editHint: Your country and business type are fixed on your payment account and cannot be changed.

issues.verificationFailed: These details could not be verified. Check them for typos and try again, or upload a document when asked.
issues.invalidInformation: Some of these details were not accepted. Check them and try again.
issues.needsAttention: This needs another look before it can be approved.

details.title: Your details
details.todo: Tell us where you are based, what you collect in, and where the widget runs. We use these to open your payment account.

identity.title: Start receiving tips
identity.todo: Give your details and a bank account, and complete a short identity check.
identity.pending: Your details are being verified. Your widget goes live as soon as this clears.
identity.done: Your widget can receive card tips.

ideal.title: Enable iDEAL
ideal.todo: Let supporters pay with iDEAL. You will be asked for an identity number and a short liveness check.
ideal.pending: Your iDEAL request is being reviewed.
ideal.unavailable: iDEAL is not available for accounts in your country.

payouts.title: Get paid out
payouts.todo: Add a bank account to receive what you collect. Tips already collected stay in your balance until then.
payouts.pending: Your bank account is being verified.
payouts.done: Payouts to your bank account are active.

payments.bannerReturn: Thanks. We are checking your setup.
payments.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
payments.errorNotConfigured: Payments are not set up yet. Please try again later.
payments.errorIdealUnavailable: iDEAL is not available for accounts in your country.
payments.errorSiteNotConfigured: Fill in your details above before you set up payments.
